changes: Added git identity to test evidence, taught DONE gate to reject missing or stale evidence HEADs, allowed metadata-only story artifact commits after a test run, improved main-sync hint to require merge main plus rerun test_story, and documented the evidence freshness rule.
usage: Run koala test_story for the story after any code, fixture, or merge-main change. DONE dry-run now shows stale Test evidence when evidence.git.head no longer covers the current story code; rerun koala test_story before DONE confirm.

limitations: DONE freshness allows commits that only touch docs/story/actives/<storyId>/ after evidence, so story metadata commits do not force another test run. Any non-story-metadata change after evidence still requires retest.
pitfalls: A strict HEAD equality check was too strict because committing test-evidence.json itself changes HEAD. The gate now checks the diff from evidence HEAD to current HEAD and only tolerates story metadata changes.
